g.text: Hurricane Erin, Category 3, is about 600 nm SW of Bermuda and 680 nm SSE of Cape Hatteras North Carolina and moving NW at 7 kt.
Tropical storm conditions are expected in Turks and Caicos Islands and Southeast Bahamas.
Beaufort Inlet to Duck, North Carolina including Pamlico Sound
Cape Lookout to Duck, North Carolina
A Tropical Storm Warning means that tropical storm conditions are expected somewhere within the warning area.
A Tropical Storm Watch means that tropical storm conditions are possible within the watch area, generally within 48 hours.
A Storm Surge Watch means there is a possibility of life-threatening inundation, from rising water moving inland from the coastline,
in the indicated locations during the next 48 hours.
680 nm SSE of Cape Hatteras North Carolina
Tropical-storm-force winds (34+ kt) reach up to 200 nm from the centre; hurricane-force (64+ kt) to 70 nm.
WHERE IT IS FORECAST TO GO (EDT)
96 and 120 hour positions are the extended outlook, not a forecast.
